Hi Laura / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today — great conversation. Quick recap from my side:

- Primary use case: customer support triage + agent assist (short generation + reranking).
- Target SLA: sub-300ms 95th for 256-token requests; throughput ~200 QPS during peak.
- Preference: reduce per-token cost while keeping quality; leaning toward dedicated reserved capacity for predictable latency and data isolation.

What we agreed to next:
1) I'll send a one-page proposal + technical appendix (attached) with a recommended config (model variant, quantization, batching knobs) and indicative pricing for hosted vs dedicated.
2) You to confirm budget window & procurement timeline (are you still targeting an EoQ decision?)
3) If useful, we can put together a short pilot scope (2–4 weeks) for a single intent to validate latency/cost.

Attached: redwood-proposal-acme-2026-03.pdf (proposal), redwood-mrap-technical-appendix.pdf (tokens/throughput assumptions).

Let me know if the above looks right — happy to schedule a 15-min sync with Aditya if your infra/security team has questions.
